title: Why Uber Still Can’t Make a Profit

sentences.zh: 这家重塑了美国交通并改变了美国

sentences.en: economy can't stop losing money.
sentences.zh: 经济的公司，一直在亏损。

sentences.en: Mike Isaac on what exactly is going on with Uber.
sentences.zh: 迈克·艾萨克为您解读优步到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: It's Thursday,
sentences.zh: 今天是星期四，

sentences.en: August 29th.
Scandal rocks Uber.
sentences.zh: 丑闻震惊优步。

sentences.en: An urgent investigation as a former employee makes explosive allegations of sexual harassment against women.
sentences.zh: 一名离职员工对女性提出爆炸性的性骚扰指控后，引发了紧急调查。

sentences.en: A former employee claims she was sexually harassed and Uber management didn't do anything about it.
sentences.zh: 一名一名前员工声称自己遭到性骚扰，而优步管理层对此置之不理。

sentences.en: In fact, she says she was ultimately criticized for reporting the problem.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她说自己因为举报了这个问题最终反而受到了批评。

sentences.en: But hers wasn't the only complaint.
sentences.zh: 但她的投诉并非个例。

sentences.en: The company's been forced to fire more than 20 people after uncovering 215 other allegations of harassment.
sentences.zh: 在发现其他 215 起骚扰指控后，该公司被迫解雇了 20 多人。

sentences.en: Facing a series of scandals, Uber sees another executive hit the door.
sentences.zh: 在面临一系列丑闻之后，优步迎来了又一位高管离职。

sentences.en: ...of another executive.
sentences.zh: ……又一位高管。

sentences.en: New trouble for the CEO of Uber.
sentences.zh: 优步 CEO 面临新麻烦。

sentences.en: Travis Kalanick is apologizing for a video showing him berating one of his own drivers.
sentences.zh: 特拉维斯·卡兰尼克正为一段训斥自己公司司机的视频道歉。

sentences.en: He now admits he needs leadership help.
sentences.zh: 他现在承认自己需要领导力方面的帮助。

sentences.en: Now to a major shakeup at Uber to tell you about the CEO and founder of the ride-sharing service.
sentences.zh: 接下来是关于优步的重大改组，为您报道这家网约车服务的 CEO 兼创始人。

sentences.en: He's out of a job this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 他在今天下午离职了。

sentences.en: Travis Kalanick.
sentences.zh: 特拉维斯·卡兰尼克。

sentences.en: Travis Kalanick is resigning as CEO.
sentences.zh: 特拉维斯·卡兰尼克正辞去 CEO 职务。

sentences.en: Now the big question, who should replace him?
sentences.zh: 现在最大的问题是，谁来接替他？

sentences.en: After being plagued by scandals, Uber is trying to get back on track with a new CEO.
sentences.zh: 在饱受丑闻困扰之后，优步正试图通过新任 CEO 重回正轨。

sentences.en: Well, Uber's new CEO is wasting no time.
sentences.zh: 好了，优步的新任 CEO 雷厉风行。

sentences.en: Dara Kashawawi says the ride-hailing company could go public in as soon as 18 months.
sentences.zh: 达拉·科斯罗萨西表示，这家网约车公司最快可能在 18 个月内上市。

sentences.en: Well, start your engines.
sentences.zh: 好了，发动引擎吧。

sentences.en: Uber pricing its IPO at $45 a share.
sentences.zh: 优步将其首次公开募股（IPO）定价为每股 45 美元。

sentences.en: This implies a market valuation of about $82.4 billion.
sentences.zh: 这意味着大约 824 亿美元的市场估值。

sentences.en: It's expected to be the largest IPO of 2019 and the biggest since Alibaba's $25 billion debut in 2014.
sentences.zh: 这预计将是 2019 年规模最大的 IPO，也是自 2014 年阿里巴巴 250 亿美元上市以来最大的一次。

sentences.en: Uber burned through a staggering amount of money in the second quarter.
sentences.zh: 优步在第二季度烧掉了惊人的资金。

sentences.en: The ride-share company said it lost
sentences.zh: 这家网约车公司表示，其亏损额达

sentences.en: $5.2 billion.
sentences.zh: 52 亿美元。

sentences.en: $5.2 billion.
sentences.zh: 52 亿美元。

sentences.en: $5.2 billion.
sentences.zh: 52 亿美元。

sentences.en: It's biggest quarterly loss ever.
sentences.zh: 这是其有史以来最大的季度亏损。

sentences.en: Mike, the last time we talked, Uber had pushed out its founder and CEO, Travis Kalanick, very publicly.
sentences.zh: 迈克，我们上次谈话时，优步公开逼走了其创始人兼 CEO 特拉维斯·卡兰尼克。

sentences.en: They vowed to change this kind of wayward, problematic corporate culture, which you spend a lot of time chronicling.
sentences.zh: 他们发誓要改变这种任性、问题重重的企业文化，而你花了大量时间记录这些。

sentences.en: They had a huge IPO that valued the company at the scale of a small country.
sentences.zh: 他们进行了一次巨大的 IPO，将公司的估值推到了一个小国家的规模。

sentences.en: All of that suggested that a corner had been turned for Uber.
sentences.zh: 所有这一切都表明优步已经度过了难关。

sentences.en: So how is it possible that just a few days ago, the company lost $5 billion?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么就在几天前，公司还会亏损 50 亿美元呢？

sentences.en: It's funny.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: I think the thing that folks don't really realize is that they have never been a profitable company in the 10 years that they've existed.
sentences.zh: 我认为大家没有真正意识到的一点是，在他们存在的 10 年里，他们从来都不是一家盈利的公司。

sentences.en: From day one, they've been bleeding money, and that's just sort of the business model that they've been predicated on.
sentences.zh: 从第一天起，他们就在流血烧钱，这正是他们赖以生存的商业模式。

sentences.en: So Uber has never once made a profit over the last decade.
sentences.zh: 所以优步在过去的十年里从来没有实现过一次盈利。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I wonder if you could explain how that's possible.
sentences.zh: 我想请你解释一下这怎么可能。

sentences.en: I think from the beginning, Travis Kalanick had this idea that is pretty common in the Valley,
sentences.zh: 我认为从一开始，特拉维斯·卡兰尼克就有这样一个在硅谷很常见的想法，

sentences.en: which is like, look, we can think about profits at some point, but it just, how can I get as many bodies in seats as possible?
sentences.zh: 那就是，听着，我们可以在某个时候考虑利润，但现在的问题是，我如何让尽可能多的人坐进车里？

sentences.en: The way he used to explain it is you have to kickstart the flywheel in each city.
sentences.zh: 他过去常解释说，你必须在每个城市启动飞轮。

sentences.en: So he sends a strike team of employees into each city, floods Craigslist with ads for free
sentences.zh: 因此，他派出一支由员工组成的突击队进入每个城市，在 Craigslist 上发布大量免费

sentences.en: rides, floods people into, you know, basically the town square, handing out coupons to drive or ride
sentences.zh: 乘车广告，把人们吸引到，你知道的，基本上是城市广场，分发优惠券让大家乘坐优步

sentences.en: with Uber and get as many bodies in the backs of seats as possible, and then take that and replicate it, you know, over and over.
sentences.zh: 或用优步开车，让尽可能多的人坐进后座，然后把这种模式，你知道的，一遍又一遍地复制。

sentences.en: Do that long enough for a long enough period of time and take over as many cities as possible.
sentences.zh: 只要持续足够长的时间，接管尽可能多的城市。

sentences.en: And then eventually you apparently can start making money off of that, provided that there are no actual competitors to your business.
sentences.zh: 然后显然你最终就可以开始从中赚钱了，前提是你的业务没有真正的竞争对手。

sentences.en: How exactly is it supposed to pay off?
sentences.zh: 这到底应该怎么获得回报呢？

sentences.en: The thesis put forth by Travis was once you get to the tipping point in any given city that Uber is
sentences.zh: 特拉维斯提出的论点是，一旦你在优步进驻的任何城市达到临界点，

sentences.en: part of your daily life, then eventually they get to a point where maybe they can hike the rates,
sentences.zh: 优步成为你日常生活的一部分，他们最终就会达到这样一个阶段：也许他们可以提高费率，

sentences.en: maybe they can lower the payment for drivers, but it doesn't matter because people are hooked and people are going to keep using it because it's part of their daily lives.
sentences.zh: 也许他们可以降低司机的报酬，但这都没关系，因为人们已经上瘾了，人们会继续使用它，因为它是他们日常生活的一部分。

sentences.en: So the plan at the beginning was spend whatever money Uber needed to spend to get people hooked on Uber, make it an essential part of people's lives.
sentences.zh: 所以最初的计划是，不惜花掉优步需要的所有钱，让人们对优步上瘾，使其成为人们生活中不可或缺的一部分。

sentences.en: And at some point, the business becomes so big, so many people use it that a profit will just inevitably come.
sentences.zh: 而在某个时候，业务变得如此庞大，以至于有这么多人使用它，利润自然就会到来。

sentences.en: The maxim he liked to use internally was transportation as reliable as running water.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢在内部使用的座右铭是“交通如自来水般可靠”。

sentences.en: Make it ubiquitous, make Uber an inevitability in every city and every country around the world, and then you can stop burning money to make it work.
sentences.zh: 使其无处不在，让优步成为全球每个城市和国家的必然选择，然后你就可以停止烧钱来维持它的运转了。

sentences.en: And Mike, how unusual was that model?
sentences.zh: 迈克，这种模式有多不寻常？

sentences.en: Burn money, build saturation, hope for a profit.
sentences.zh: 烧钱，建立饱和度，寄希望于利润。

sentences.en: I mean, Facebook's actually a good example of that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，Facebook 其实就是一个很好的例子。

sentences.en: You know, burned a lot of money with no advertising for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在很长一段时间里，在没有任何广告的情况下烧了很多钱。

sentences.en: The other one that is a pretty classic case is Amazon.
sentences.zh: 另一个相当经典的案例是亚马逊。

sentences.en: From the beginning of that business, Jeff Bezos actually trained Wall Street to allow Amazon to lose money because they were often losing money every quarter or maybe break
sentences.zh: 从该业务创立之初，杰夫·贝佐斯实际上就训练华尔街允许亚马逊亏损，因为他们经常每个季度都在亏损，或者最多勉强

sentences.en: even at beSt. And his whole thing was, look, we need to spend money to make money.
sentences.zh: 收支平衡。他的一贯观点是，听着，我们需要花钱才能赚钱。

sentences.en: We need to get as many people using our site as possible.
sentences.zh: 我们需要让尽可能多的人使用我们的网站。

sentences.en: And that habituates them into making us part of their everyday lives.
sentences.zh: 这让他们习惯于让我们成为他们日常生活的一部分。

sentences.en: And clearly that theory was right.
sentences.zh: 显然，这个理论是正确的。

sentences.en: So investors have been used to this type of business model for a long time, and they were happy to pour money into Uber from the very beginning.
sentences.zh: 因此，投资者长期以来一直习惯这种商业模式，他们从一开始就很乐意向优步倾注资金。

sentences.en: And they did in a really huge way to the tune of, you know, billions.
sentences.zh: 而且他们以一种真正巨大的方式做到了这一点，数额达到了，你知道的，数十亿美元。

sentences.en: Uber has raised more than $1 billion from institutional backers, which of course does include Goldman Sachs and several venture
sentences.zh: 优步已从机构支持者那里筹集了超过 10 亿美元，其中当然包括高盛和几家风险

sentences.en: capital firMs. Google invested almost a billion in Uber.
sentences.zh: 投资公司。谷歌向优步投资了近 10 亿美元。

sentences.en: That's the biggest they've invested in anything ever.
sentences.zh: 这是他们有史以来最大的一笔投资。

sentences.en: According to the New York Times, Saudi Arabia's public investment fund has infused
sentences.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，沙特阿拉伯的主权财富基金已向总部位于旧金山的优步

sentences.en: $3.5 billion in San Francisco-based Uber.
sentences.zh: 注资 35 亿美元。

sentences.en: And what is Uber doing with all of these billions of dollars that investors are handing over?
sentences.zh: 优步用投资者交出的这数十亿美元在做什么？

sentences.en: So let's break it down to like the granular level.
sentences.zh: 让我们把它细化到微观层面。

sentences.en: Imagine that a ride costs $10, right?
sentences.zh: 假设一次行程花费 10 美元，对吧？

sentences.en: Uber might pay $2 or $3 out of that ride just to make it cheaper for a rider.
sentences.zh: 优步可能会从这次行程中支付 2 或 3 美元，只是为了让乘客更便宜。

sentences.en: So you or I might pay like $7 to get somewhere, where in reality it costs $10.
sentences.zh: 所以你我可能只花 7 美元就能去某个地方，而实际上它成本是 10 美元。

sentences.en: 30% of that goes to the driver.
sentences.zh: 其中 30% 归司机所有。

sentences.en: So at the end of the day, Uber ends up making like $2 or $3 on the ride, but count all their overhead and maybe they lose a dollar or two on the ride.
sentences.zh: 所以到头来，优步在这次行程上最终只能赚到 2 或 3 美元，但算上他们所有的间接费用，可能在这次行程上还要亏损一两美元。

sentences.en: Now multiply that by millions of rides per day in each city across, you know, the United States and then move out to the United States.
sentences.zh: 现在，将这个数字乘以美国每个城市每天数百万次的行程，然后再扩展到全美国。

sentences.en: And then there's millions more in other cities outwards.
sentences.zh: 还有其他城市向外延伸的数百万次行程。

sentences.en: So, you know, in theory, they might be losing millions of dollars in each city every single day.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，从理论上讲，他们在每个城市每天可能会损失数百万美元。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So not only are they actually paying for riders and drivers to take rides, but part of their strategy was barrel into a new city and, you know, forget about the consequences.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不仅实际上在为乘客和司机的行程补贴资金，而且他们的策略还包括冲进一个新城市，然后，你知道的，抛开后果不谈。

sentences.en: We can actually like afford to pay them off.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上可以负担得起收买他们的费用。

sentences.en: So whether that's in, you know, Southeast Asia, where they were literally allegedly bribing police officers to operate in
sentences.zh: 所以无论是在，你知道的，东南亚，他们据称曾在那里字面意思上贿赂警察以便在

sentences.en: certain areas or in China, where they were burning billions of dollars, some of those going to fake rides, tons of scammers.
sentences.zh: 某些地区运营，还是在中国，他们在那里烧掉了数十亿美元，其中一些用于虚假行程和大量的骗子。

sentences.en: They're actually organized crime rings set up entirely to scam Uber out of, you know, millions, if not billions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 甚至有完全为了诈骗优步数百万甚至数十亿美元而组建的有组织犯罪团伙。

sentences.en: And Travis's idea was it doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 而特拉维斯的想法是，这没关系。

sentences.en: This is a cost of doing business.
sentences.zh: 这是做生意的成本。

sentences.en: And so this is how we need to push through.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我们需要度过难关的方式。

sentences.en: So Uber is not just subsidizing each ride.
sentences.zh: 因此，优步不仅仅是在补贴每一次行程。

sentences.en: They are having to pay in all these other ways around the world just to keep on growing and growing into new markets beyond the U.S.
sentences.zh: 为了在全球范围内不断增长并进军美国以外的新市场，他们不得不以所有这些其他方式花钱。

sentences.en: And the idea, right, is that this will still someday pay off and turn into profit.
sentences.zh: 而这个想法，对吧，是这一切终有一天会得到回报并转化为利润。

sentences.en: Yep, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没、错。

sentences.en: Okay, so they're getting a foothold into all these markets in cities across the world.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以他们在全球各城市的许多市场都站稳了脚跟。

sentences.en: Did it seem like it was all going according to plan, that people were starting to become hooked on Uber in the way that its founders had expected?
sentences.zh: 这看起来是否一切都按计划进行，人们是否开始像其创始人所期望的那样对优步上瘾了？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, if you think back to 2015, 2016, Uber was on top of the world.
sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，如果你回想 2015、2016 年，优步正处于世界的巅峰。

sentences.en: Uber, okay, doing a great job, right?
sentences.zh: 优步，好的，干得好，对吧？

sentences.en: We all like Uber.
sentences.zh: 我们都喜欢优步。

sentences.en: Here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 问题是这样的。

sentences.en: Every decade, there's a company that comes along that changes everything.
sentences.zh: 每十年，都会有一家公司出现并改变一切。

sentences.en: It all started as a ride-sharing app, and it's exploded into a global force disrupting the entire transportation industry.
sentences.zh: 这一切都始于一个网约车应用，如今它已爆发为一股全球力量，颠覆了整个交通行业。

sentences.en: The ride-sharing company's most recent funding round giving Uber a valuation of, get this, $68 billion.
sentences.zh: 这家网约车公司最近一轮融资对优步的估值达到了，你猜怎么着，680 亿美元。

sentences.en: Now that brings us- They were open in almost every continent.
sentences.zh: 现在这把我们——他们在几乎所有大陆都开业了。

sentences.en: They were actually crushing their competition.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上在压制竞争对手。

sentences.en: Lyft was on its deathbed, basically, you know, trying to get people to use the service, but it seemed like Uber really was going to win.
sentences.zh: Lyft 基本上已经奄奄一息了，你知道的，努力让人使用这项服务，但看起来优步确实要赢了。

sentences.en: And then 2017 happened.
sentences.zh: 然后 2017 年发生了。

sentences.en: In the past year, the company has faced crisis after crisis, including accusations of stealing self-driving technology from Google and protests by drivers.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一年里，该公司面临着一场又一场危机，包括被指控窃取谷歌的自动驾驶技术以及司机的抗议。

sentences.en: Hashtag delete Uber.
sentences.zh: 话题标签“删除优步”。

sentences.en: People around the world are deleting their Uber app because of Uber's link with President Trump.
sentences.zh: 世界各地的人们都在删除他们的优步应用，因为优步与特朗普总统有关联。

sentences.en: But today, the CEO of Uber is out.
sentences.zh: 但今天，优步的 CEO 离职了。

sentences.en: It was an investor revolt that led Travis
sentences.zh: 是一场投资者起义导致特拉维斯

sentences.en: Kalanick to resign after months of turmoil.
sentences.zh: 卡兰尼克在经历了几个月的动荡后辞职。

sentences.en: Just a long- A lot of this stuff cemented the idea in people's heads that Uber is this gross, bro-tastic company, and I shouldn't use the product.
sentences.zh: 经历了一长串——许多这样的事情巩固了人们心中的想法，即优步是一家恶心、满是直男癌的公司，我不应该使用它的产品。

sentences.en: And I think the thing that people didn't really quite realize is that that actually really affected their business.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们没有真正意识到的是，这实际上真的影响了他们的业务。

sentences.en: Folks started actually using Lyft as a way to say, I don't use Uber.
sentences.zh: 人们开始真正使用 Lyft 作为一种表态：我不用优步。

sentences.en: It brought it back from the brink and sort of like revived this competitor.
sentences.zh: 这把它从悬崖边缘拉了回来，并且某种程度上复活了这个竞争对手。

sentences.en: It's this war that ultimately never ends for them and keeps kicking the idea of profitability further and further down the line just because
sentences.zh: 这是一场对他们而言最终永无止境的战争，并不断将盈利的想法一推再推，只因为

sentences.en: they're always competing and there's always someone new popping up ready to make you spend more money.
sentences.zh: 他们总是在竞争，总会有新人冒出来让你花更多的钱。

sentences.en: So what does Uber have to do to adjust to this new problematic environment?
sentences.zh: 那么优步必须做些什么来适应这个充满问题的新环境呢？

sentences.en: So Uber's answer is to spread into a bunch more money-losing businesses.
sentences.zh: 所以优步的对策是涉足更多亏损的业务。

sentences.en: Folks need food?
sentences.zh: 人们需要食物？

sentences.en: Not bring it to them.
sentences.zh: 把它们送过去。

sentences.en: I've been called a liaison of Linguine, the convoy of cakes.
sentences.zh: 我曾被称为意大利面的联络员、蛋糕的车队。

sentences.en: Most people just look out their window and say, hey, Uber Eats dude.
sentences.zh: 大多数人只是往窗外一看，说，嘿，那个送优步外卖的家伙。

sentences.en: They started moving into Uber Eats, their food delivery service.
sentences.zh: 他们开始涉足 Uber Eats，即他们的食品外卖服务。

sentences.en: They're the latest addition to the bike share craze with a twiSt. Jump is an electric bike that gives you a boost to cover more ground with every pedal.
sentences.zh: 他们是单车共享热潮的最新加入者，不过带点新花样。Jump 是一辆电动自行车，每次踩踏板都能为你提供动力，助你骑行得更远。

sentences.en: They bought this company called Jump, which creates e-bikes and scooters in a bunch of different cities and decided to start replicating that all over the place.
sentences.zh: 他们收购了一家名为 Jump 的公司，该公司在许多不同的城市制造电动自行车和滑板车，并决定开始到处复制这种模式。

sentences.en: Everyone knows about Uber and the way it's transformed the taxi business.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道优步及其对出租车行业带来的变革。

sentences.en: But have you ever heard of Uber Freight?
sentences.zh: 但你听说过 Uber Freight 吗？

sentences.en: Think of it as Uber for truck drivers.
sentences.zh: 你可以把它看作是卡车司机的 Uber。

sentences.en: They basically took the thesis that we need to spend money to make money in one category and put that into all these different lines of
sentences.zh: 他们基本上采取了这样一种逻辑：我们需要在一个领域花钱来赚钱，然后把这种逻辑投入到所有这些不同的业务中

sentences.en: business to expand on the idea that we're not just a ride-hailing company.
sentences.zh: 以扩展这样一个理念，即我们不仅仅是一家网约车公司。

sentences.en: We are a transportation platform.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个交通平台。

sentences.en: And we want Uber to be every part of your life from, you know, commuting to work to getting a McDonald's delivered to your house at the end of the day.
sentences.zh: 我们希望 Uber 融入你生活的方方面面，你知道的，从通勤上班到最终在家收到一份麦当劳外卖。

sentences.en: And the idea within this platform is still to subsidize each of these experiences.
sentences.zh: 在这个平台内部，其核心理念仍然是补贴每一项体验。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, again, getting back into that cycle of we need to grow as fast as possible.
sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，话说回来，这又回到了那个我们需要以尽可能快的速度增长的循环中。

sentences.en: And that means giving freebies away to customers as well as, like, getting drivers to deliver as many pieces of food as possible.
sentences.zh: 这意味着向客户赠送免费礼品，同时让司机尽可能多地配送食物。

sentences.en: And I just read a report the other day that they probably aren't going to expect profitability from Uber Eats for a very long time, probably years out.
sentences.zh: 我前几天刚读到一份报告，他们可能在很长一段时间内都不会指望 Uber Eats 实现盈利，也许要等好几年。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 免费解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费体验《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App 时，你在该 App 的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，请在今天下载《时报》App，并获得 30 天的免费使用权限。

sentences.en: Mike, so let's talk about why this business model hasn't worked for Uber.
sentences.zh: 迈克，那我们来谈谈为什么这种商业模式对 Uber 为什么行不通。

sentences.en: Because as you said earlier, this theoretically can work.
sentences.zh: 因为正如你刚才所说，理论上这应该是行得通的。

sentences.en: It has worked for Amazon, for Facebook.
sentences.zh: 它对亚马逊、对 Facebook 都行之有效。

sentences.en: So what is so uniquely non-functional about it for Uber?
sentences.zh: 那么，对 Uber 来说，究竟是什么让它如此独特地无法运转呢？

sentences.en: The first 10 years of Amazon's business, they spent building out warehouses.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊业务的前 10 年，他们把钱花在建造仓库上。

sentences.en: They spent sort of building new infrastructure and things that can't be easily replicated by a bunch of their competitors.
sentences.zh: 他们花钱建立新的基础设施以及一些无法被其众多竞争对手轻易复制的东西。

sentences.en: The first 10 years of Uber's business were just spent growing and creating this network.
sentences.zh: Uber 业务的前 10 年仅仅花在了增长和建立这个网络上。

sentences.en: But as it turns out, you can catch a ride from anyone and not really care much about who you're getting it from.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，你可以随便找个人搭车，而且并不怎么在意你是从谁那里坐的车。

sentences.en: So whereas Amazon, you know, I'm locked in.
sentences.zh: 所以与亚马逊不同，你知道的，我被绑定了。

sentences.en: I have my Prime subscription.
sentences.zh: 我有我的 Prime 订阅。

sentences.en: You know,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，

sentences.en: I'm not going to go to Walmart.com or Jet or whatever, because Amazon's hooked into my life.
sentences.zh: 我不会去 Walmart.com 或 Jet 之类的网站，因为亚马逊已经融入了我的生活。

sentences.en: But Uber, I could give or take, depending on what service I feel most comfortable riding with.
sentences.zh: 但对于 Uber，我可去可不去，这取决于我觉得坐哪家服务最舒服。

sentences.en: So add to that the idea that Uber's brand has been toxic and sort of tainted with people and their minds.
sentences.zh: 因此，再加上这样一种观点，即 Uber 的品牌一直是有毒的，并且在某种程度上被玷污了人们的看法和心智。

sentences.en: And the idea that they could easily go to a competitor like Lyft or Didi in China and Brazil or Ola in India.
sentences.zh: 还有一种情况是，他们可以轻易转向竞争对手，比如在中国和巴西的 Lyft 或滴滴，或者在印度的 Ola。

sentences.en: And at the end of the day, what has Uber really built in terms of its defense against its other competitors?
sentences.zh: 归根结底，在抵御其他竞争对手方面，Uber 真正建立起了什么防御措施？

sentences.en: So, Mike, you're saying it's comparatively quite easy to compete with Uber in a way that it's not with a company like Amazon.
sentences.zh: 所以，迈克，你的意思是，与亚马逊这样的公司不同，与 Uber 竞争在某种程度上是比较容易的。

sentences.en: And yet I wonder, why did it take Uber this long to recognize this problem?
sentences.zh: 然而我想知道，为什么 Uber 花了这么长时间才认识到这个问题？

sentences.en: The idea that it is so easy to compete based on the technology here seems like something that the founders and the investors would have absorbed pretty early on.
sentences.zh: 基于这里的技术进行竞争是如此容易，这种想法似乎是创始人和投资者很早就应该意识到的。

sentences.en: I mean, it seems obvious in retrospect, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，事后看来这似乎显而易见，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's hard to think back to 2010, 2011, but Uber really was the only game in town back then.
sentences.zh: 很难回想起 2010 年、2011 年的情况，但那时 Uber 确实是城里唯一的玩家。

sentences.en: Like all these competitors didn't really exiSt. They were able to raise billions of dollars dollars.
sentences.zh: 就像所有这些竞争对手当时并不真的存在一样。他们当时能够筹集到数十亿美元资金。

sentences.en: Travis would sort of block investors from investing in competing companies.
sentences.zh: 特拉维斯会阻止投资者投资竞争对手公司。

sentences.en: And it seemed like they were remaking the whole economy, right?
sentences.zh: 而且他们似乎在重塑整个经济，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, I remember when the idea of a gig worker was just totally novel and new and they were the ones offering it to folks.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我记得当零工经济的概念完全新颖且前所未有的时候，他们就是向人们提供这一概念的人。

sentences.en: And this was going to upend how people were working.
sentences.zh: 这将彻底颠覆人们的工作方式。

sentences.en: And now think of how many businesses are the Uber for X.
sentences.zh: 现在想想有多少企业是各行各业的 Uber（即 Uber for X）。

sentences.en: If you don't want to go work for Uber, you can go work for DoorDash or TaskRabbit or whatever.
sentences.zh: 如果你不想为 Uber 工作，你可以去为 DoorDash、TaskRabbit 或其他什么公司工作。

sentences.en: It's really not fundamentally that difficult of a business when you can easily replicate it as a competitor.
sentences.zh: 当你能被竞争对手轻易复制时，它从根本上来说真的不是一项那么难的业务。

sentences.en: And I think the idea that this business is not that defensible really came on quickly, especially when Uber was having just a nightmare 2017.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这项业务防守性没那么强这一观点很快就显现出来了，尤其是当 Uber 正经历噩梦般的 2017 年时。

sentences.en: And now they've had to really shift a lot of the assumptions that they had early on that Uber was going to be the only company to go to.
sentences.zh: 现在他们不得不真正改变许多早期的假设，即 Uber 将成为人们唯一的首选公司。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So that's been a tough shift for them.
sentences.zh: 所以这对他们来说是一个艰难的转变。

sentences.en: They've really had to change very quickly in a very short amount of time.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不在极短的时间内非常迅速地做出改变。

sentences.en: I have to imagine at this point, as Uber is posting billions of dollars in losses in a single quarter, that those original investors in the company who bet on this
sentences.zh: 我禁不住想象，此时此刻，随着 Uber 在单季度公布数十亿美元的亏损，公司那些押注于这个

sentences.en: dominant strategy that has not yet come to fruition are very unhappy.
sentences.zh: 尚未实现的统治战略的最初投资者一定非常不高兴。

sentences.en: Uh, no, I think they're actually pretty happy.
sentences.zh: 呃，不，我认为他们其实挺高兴的。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Everyone who got in early on Uber made a killing.
sentences.zh: 每一个早期投资 Uber 的人都赚大发了。

sentences.en: You know, there was one guy who parked $5,000 in the company early on, and that turned into a
sentences.zh: 你知道的，曾有一个人在早期向该公司投入了 5,000 美元，这后来变成了一笔

sentences.en: $20 million investment for him.
sentences.zh: 2,000 万美元的投资回报。

sentences.en: And he did absolutely nothing.
sentences.zh: 而他什么也没做。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: You know, anyone who got their money in on the ground floor is very happy with how things turned out.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，任何在底层投入资金的人对事情的结果都非常满意。

sentences.en: I mean, how exactly is that possible if the company has never made any money?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果这家公司从未挣过钱，这到底是怎么可能的？

sentences.en: Anyone who bought shares in Uber early on, all they had to do was basically spot the idea and sit on their investment for years.
sentences.zh: 任何早期购买 Uber 股票的人，他们所需要做的基本上就是发现这个点子，然后把投资放着不管好几年。

sentences.en: So by the time you get to an initial public offering, which is when people like you and me
sentences.zh: 因此，当你迎来首次公开募股（IPO）时，也就是像你我这样的人

sentences.en: can actually buy shares of this company, those early investors can sell their shares at an insane profit.
sentences.zh: 真正可以买这家公司股票的时候，那些早期投资者就可以以疯狂的利润卖出他们的股票。

sentences.en: The company is worth billions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 这家公司价值数十亿美元。

sentences.en: All of the gains that they realized have occurred in the 10 years that they were a private company.
sentences.zh: 他们实现的所有收益都发生在他们作为私营公司的这 10 年里。

sentences.en: Whereas you and I are buying shares on day one and just hoping that that company value continues to go up in the future.
sentences.zh: 而你和我则是在第一天购买股票，只是希望这家公司的价值在未来能继续上涨。

sentences.en: And on day one of Uber's IPO, the value has only continued to plummet.
sentences.zh: 而在 Uber IPO 的第一天，其价值却一直在暴跌。

sentences.en: And anyone who bought shares on the first day have only lost money essentially.
sentences.zh: 任何在第一天购买股票的人基本上都只亏了钱。

sentences.en: So I think Uber has been a wonderful business for venture capitalists because it made them a ton of money early on.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为 Uber 对风险投资家来说是一桩划算的生意，因为它在早期为他们赚了巨额资金。

sentences.en: I wonder if Uber is a wonderful business for normal people who want it to be profitable one day.
sentences.zh: 我不知道对于那些希望 Uber 有朝一日能盈利的普通人来说，它是不是一桩好生意。

sentences.en: But that really is how companies work out here.
sentences.zh: 但这里公司的运作方式确实如此。

sentences.en: You know, if you're an early VC, you kind of don't care, you know, the fate of these
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果你是一个早期的 VC（风险投资人），你其实并不太关心这些

sentences.en: companies and whether they turn into viable businesses because you made your money early and then you can get out.
sentences.zh: 公司的命运，也不关心它们是否能变成具有可行性的业务，因为你很早就赚到了钱，然后就可以脱身。

sentences.en: So for the super wealthy early investors, it isn't necessarily a problem that Uber has never made money.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于超级富有的早期投资者来说，Uber 从未赚过钱不一定是个问题。

sentences.en: Those investors did make a huge amount of money from the IPO.
sentences.zh: 那些投资者确实从 IPO 中赚取了巨额财富。

sentences.en: And I wonder if you think that that fact, that reality of how things work out there in Silicon Valley has contributed to the kind
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否认为这一事实——即硅谷事情运作方式的现实——促成了

sentences.en: of growth that Uber experienced, which was this kind of heedless subsidized investment into profitability that never materialized.
sentences.zh: Uber 所经历的那种增长，也就是这种无谋的、对从未实现的盈利进行补贴的投资。

sentences.en: Yes, that's common out here.
sentences.zh: 是的，这在硅谷很常见。

sentences.en: And I think that's just going to continue occurring because that's how the model works.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这种现象还会继续发生，因为这就是该模式的运作方式。

sentences.en: So, Mike, what happens now?
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: Uber can't continue hemorrhaging billions of dollars forever.
sentences.zh: Uber 不可能永远流失数十亿美元。

sentences.en: And at this point, a decade is starting to feel kind of like forever.
sentences.zh: 而且在这个时候，十年开始让人感觉像是永远。

sentences.en: Well, you know, they're doing a lot of different little short-term things right now to try and save money, doing some layoffs in their marketing department, cutting back on the
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，他们现在正在做很多不同的短期小举措来试图省钱，在他们的营销部门进行一些裁员，削减给员工的

sentences.en: birthday balloons that they give to employees each anniversary, which is going to save them like
sentences.zh: 每个周年纪念日发放的生日气球，这将为他们每年节省大约

sentences.en: 200 grand a year.
sentences.zh: 20 万美元。

sentences.en: $200,000 on employee balloons.
sentences.zh: 在员工气球上节省 20 万美元。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's a big expense for them.
sentences.zh: 是的，这对他们来说是一笔大开支。

sentences.en: But I think the bigger questions of how long are we going to stay in this business?
sentences.zh: 但我认为更大的问题是，我们要在这项业务中坚持多久？

sentences.en: Are scooters, you know, something we can actually make money from?
sentences.zh: 滑板车，你知道的，是我们真正能从中赚钱的东西吗？

sentences.en: When do we stop competing on food delivery and spending insane amounts of money to compete in India or Brazil or wherever else we're losing money?
sentences.zh: 我们什么时候停止在餐饮配送上进行竞争，停止花疯了的钱去印度、巴西或其他任何我们正在亏损的地方竞争？

sentences.en: I think probably they have maybe one or two years of time before, you know, the stock really starts taking a hit.
sentences.zh: 我想他们大概有一到两年的时间，然后，你知道的，股票才会真正受到打击。

sentences.en: And plus, the bank account doesn't last forever.
sentences.zh: 而且另外，银行账户里的钱不会永远持续下去。

sentences.en: They only have X amount of dollars of cash on hand.
sentences.zh: 他们手里只有一定数量的现金。

sentences.en: So I imagine within the next two years, they have to really decide what is core to being
sentences.zh: 所以我设想在未来两年内，他们必须真正决定什么是

sentences.en: Uber.
sentences.zh: Uber 的核心。

sentences.en: What is core to our business?
sentences.zh: 什么才是我们业务的核心？

sentences.en: And what can we continue doing without losing money that people will actually use and make us a viable business in the long term?
sentences.zh: 我们如何在不亏损的情况下继续做那些人们真正会使用、并能在长期内使我们成为一家可行企业的业务？

sentences.en: Okay, so let's say Uber doesn't figure out how to make a profit before it runs out of money.
sentences.zh: 好吧，假设 Uber 在资金耗尽之前没有弄清楚如何实现盈利。

sentences.en: And perhaps the company stops operating.
sentences.zh: 也许这家公司停止运营了。

sentences.en: What will Uber's effect have been on all of our lives?
sentences.zh: Uber 对我们所有人的生活将会产生什么影响？

sentences.en: I think the sort of ironic point here is that Uber pioneered a category like ride sharing and delivery and on-demand services.
sentences.zh: 我认为这里有点讽刺的地方在于，Uber 开创了网约车、外卖和按需服务这样一个品类。

sentences.en: And that's, you know, you have to give them a lot of credit for that.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，你必须为此给予他们很多赞誉。

sentences.en: But that can exist in a world without Uber.
sentences.zh: 但这可以在没有 Uber 的世界里存在。

sentences.en: I think on-demand services are always going to be here, whether Uber figures out its business model or not.
sentences.zh: 我认为按需服务将永远存在，不管 Uber 是否理顺了它的商业模式。

sentences.en: I think another thing is in the past 10 years of drivers flooding into cities and the way Uber has changed how people get around, it really has
sentences.zh: 我认为另一件事是，在过去 10 年里司机涌入城市以及 Uber 改变人们出行方式的方式，它确实

sentences.en: fundamentally changed how cities operate now.
sentences.zh: 从根本上改变了城市现在的运作方式。

sentences.en: They've created entire new pickup zones and airports for people to get Ubers.
sentences.zh: 他们在机场为人们乘坐 Uber 创建了全新的上车点。

sentences.en: Public transportation funding isn't what it was because ridership might be down in certain cities.
sentences.zh: 公共交通资金已经不如从前了，因为某些城市的乘客量可能会下降。

sentences.en: And people that can't afford to take Ubers may not be having the greatest experience on a bus or a subway now just because of how that's affected it.
sentences.zh: 那些负担不起 Uber 费用的人现在在公交车或地铁上的体验可能不是最好的，这仅仅是因为它受到了这种影响。

sentences.en: I think Uber will have this lasting impact on cities and how we get around, whether it continues to exist or not.
sentences.zh: 我认为无论 Uber 是否继续存在，它都将对城市以及我们的出行方式产生这种持久的影响。

sentences.en: And I don't know if that's always a positive thing, but I think it's going to affect us for a pretty long time to come in ways we haven't even really thought about.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这是否总是一件积极的事情，但我认为它会在我们甚至还没有真正想到的方面，在相当长的一段时间内影响我们。

sentences.en: So in the end, like, Uber accomplishes something pretty extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 所以到头来，Uber 完成了一些非常了不起的事情。

sentences.en: It creates a new industry.
sentences.zh: 它创造了一个新行业。

sentences.en: It changes how millions of Americans travel, how cities, as you just said, think about transportation.
sentences.zh: 它改变了数百万美国人的出行方式，改变了正如你刚才所说城市对交通运输的看法。

sentences.en: It challenges and undermines this iconic American industry of taxi cabs.
sentences.zh: 它挑战并削弱了美国标志性的出租车行业。

sentences.en: In many ways, it creates the gig economy.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，它催生了零工经济。

sentences.en: It does all of that, but it just never builds a profitable business.
sentences.zh: 它做到了这一切，但它就是从未建立起一个盈利的业务。

sentences.en: And that may mean it doesn't operate as that business.
sentences.zh: 这可能意味着它无法作为那项业务运转下去。

sentences.en: I mean, whether you think that's a tragedy or a comedy or whatever, I think that's just pretty emblematic of how businesses work out here.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，无论你认为这是一场悲剧、喜剧还是别的什么，我认为这恰恰象征着硅谷企业的运作方式。

sentences.en: In Silicon Valley, there have been more startups that have been more transformative on how the world operates in the past 10 years than I can really even think to remember.
sentences.zh: 在硅谷，过去 10 年里，有比我能想到的还要多的初创公司，它们对世界的运作方式产生了变革性的影响。

sentences.en: And a lot of them continue to burn cash and don't make money on the public markets
sentences.zh: 其中许多公司继续烧钱，在公开市场上不赚钱

sentences.en: and don't, maybe don't plan to and continue selling that idea to people that this business doesn't have to make money right away.
sentences.zh: 而且也许并不打算赚钱，并继续向人们兜售这样一种理念：这项业务不必立即赚钱。

sentences.en: And I don't see that changing anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 我看不出这种情景在短期内会有什么改变。

sentences.en: Turns out whether your company actually makes money or not, it can still end up affecting billions of people around the world.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，无论你的公司是否真的赚钱，它最终仍然可以影响全世界数十亿人。

sentences.en: Mike, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 迈克，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Hey, thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 嘿，谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, in an unusual mood, Britain's new prime minister, Boris Johnson, announced a plan to
sentences.zh: 周三，英国新任首相鲍里斯·约翰逊在一种不同寻常的情绪下，宣布了一项计划：

sentences.en: shut down Parliament for several weeks in what appeared to be an extraordinary attempt to silence opponents of his plans to leave the European Union.
sentences.zh: 让议会休会数周，这似乎是一次非同寻常的尝试，旨在压制那些反对他离开欧盟计划的反对派声音。

sentences.en: The decision drew outrage from members of Parliament who compared the manoeuvre to a coup.
sentences.zh: 这一决定引发了议员们的愤怒，他们将这一政治手腕比作一场政变。

sentences.en: It's absolutely outrageous.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是令人发指的。

sentences.en: And if MPs don't come together next week to stop Boris Johnson in his tracks, then I think today will go down in history as the day UK democracy died.
sentences.zh: 如果议员们下周不能团结一致来阻止鲍里斯·约翰逊的企图，那么我认为今天将被载入史册，成为英国民主消亡的日子。

sentences.en: Officially, the decision to shut down Parliament must be made by the Queen.
sentences.zh: 官方规定，让议会休会的决定必须由女王做出。

sentences.en: And hours after Johnson proposed the idea, the Queen, as is customary, quickly approved the plan.
sentences.zh: 在约翰逊提出该想法几小时后，女王按照惯例迅速批准了该计划。

sentences.en: Anne.
sentences.zh: 安。

sentences.en: Hey, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: I wanted you to hear it from me firSt. But after more than eight incredible months,
sentences.zh: 我希望你们能第一时间听到我亲口说出。但在经历了了不起的八个多月之后，

sentences.en: I'm ending my presidential campaign.
sentences.zh: 我正在结束我的总统竞选。

sentences.en: Senator Kirsten Gillibrand of New York, who campaigned for president as a champion of women and families, is dropping out of the 2020 race.
sentences.zh: 来自纽约的参议员基尔斯滕·吉利布兰德（Kirsten Gillibrand）曾以女性和家庭捍卫者的身份参加总统竞选，她现在正退出 2020 年的竞选。

sentences.en: I know this isn't the result we wanted.
sentences.zh: 我知道这不是我们想要的结果。

sentences.en: We wanted to win this race.
sentences.zh: 我们本想赢得这场竞选。

sentences.en: But it's important to know when it's not your time and to know how you can best serve your community and country.
sentences.zh: 但重要的是要知道什么时候不属于你的时代，并知道如何最好地服务于你的社区和国家。

sentences.en: Gillibrand failed to qualify for the third presidential debate scheduled for next month, a development that she described as fatal to her candidacy.
sentences.zh: 吉利布兰德未能获得定于下个月举行的第三场总统辩论的资格，她将这一进展描述为对她候选资格的致命打击。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》（The Daily）的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党便陷入了一场激烈、混乱且有时令人兴奋的权斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》节目中，我是萨拉·凯尼格，我们将讲述人们试图维持自身影响力却在过程中失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
